purpose: Per-(target, rule) CEILINGS for docs/chipalooza/measure_metal_min_area.py, so the PDK-gated CI gate (issue #338) can fail on a sub-minimum-area shape THIS repo's generators draw while not red-lining on the shapes klayout-tools' own place-and-route emits (issue #333). Every entry below is #333's; there is no other kind of entry, and there must never be one without a tracking issue.
retirement: When #333 closes, DELETE this file and drop --baseline from that CI step. Nothing else references it. Until then, a target/rule whose count drops below its allowance is reported as a STALE ALLOWANCE (a warning, not a failure) so the gate cannot quietly outlive the finding.

attribution.how_these_counts_were_derived: Measured on the records below with `layout/.venv/bin/python docs/chipalooza/measure_metal_min_area.py`. The composed top level's counts are exactly the sum of the two place-and-routed digital macros' counts, rule by rule (m1.6 96+18=114, m2.6 6+0=6, m3.6 8+0=8, m5.4 2+15=17), which is how every one of the 145 shapes is attributed to place-and-route rather than to any hand-authored generator: the composition adds none of its own. The three flows this repo hand-authors geometry for end to end -- cdac-array, comparator, sampling-frontend -- measure 0 and deliberately appear nowhere below, so they are gated at zero.
